Houthi attacks disrupt Saudi energy facilities and injure dozens in the kingdom. The UK is set to announce a trade ban on goods made in Israeli West Bank settlements. Europe pledges over $230 million to Greenland as it vies for influence in the Arctic. Germany's far-right AfD falls short of a majority in Saxony-Anhalt and faces messy coalition talks. And Huawei drops a luxury foldable smartphone just days before Apple is expected to enter the foldable market.
